notes.title: REMEMBER WHEN: THE PROMISE | RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Hey all, 

First of all I would like to say a giant thank you to everyone who has played, watched or experienced the story of Remember When in any way.  

Your love and support is the reason I continue to do what I do, and this post is for you.

Ever since the release of the game, I’ve had this concept in mind.

I knew where I wanted each character to go from there, and I was debating on how to do it.

Originally, I pitched the core premise & elements of this as a sequel, but the content just wasn’t enough. It wouldn’t work.

However, I still wanted to tell this story and give these characters a proper send-off.

So, without further ado, I present…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39633173/6566b2098f6b2f71f3c1be9208b762b84508652b.png
Remember When: The Promise

You can access it from my personal website here.

This short story serves as an epilogue and canonical ending to the story of Remember When which, if you haven’t played yet, is FREE on Steam!

With this story finally out, I can bid these characters farewell and move on to new and exciting stuff!

If you’ve played the original or even watched a playthrough of it on YouTube, thank you from the bottom of my heart.

I hope you enjoy reading this, as much as I enjoyed writing it.

Onwards now to the next adventure!

Thank you again,

Lefkos Savvides
Arrow Games

notes.title: UPDATE - Various fixes & new feature!
notes.notes:
A new update has been released with various optimisations that aim to address all the issues reported by players being stuck on the phone at the beginning of the game!

Alongside those, the following have been added:

- Added a HOME Button on the UI
- Added a feature to Skip Dialogue (Availability indicated on UI)

notes.title: UPDATE - Various fixes & new feature!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Thank you for your continuous feedback and support for Remember When!

A new update has been released with various optimisations that aim to address all the issues reported by players being stuck on the phone at the beginning of the game!

Alongside those, the following have been added:

- Added a HOME Button on the UI
- Added a feature to Skip Dialogue (Availability indicated on UI)

One again, thank you for playing and enjoying Remember When!

You can find, and contact us on Twitter

Stay awesome!

Lefkos Savvides
Arrow Games

notes.title: Important bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, thank you for playing Remember When and providing us with constructive feedback.

We've been made aware of a critical issue that prevented players from using their mouse to move around in the Hub areas. 

This update aims to address that issue and the game should now be able to be played normally, thank you for your patience!

Please continue to provide us with feedback, whether that is any issues you may encounter or your thoughts about the story and characters! :) 

Our goal is to improve and make Remember When the best experience it can be! 

Sincerely,

Lefkos Savvides
ArrowGames
